question: Q-W-S1-D2
text: For that Sales Territory, which 10 stock items contributed the most FY2015 revenue, and what share of the territory's revenue do they represent together?
interpretation: For the territory with the highest FY2015 revenue: the 10 stock items with the most FY2015 revenue, each item's share of the territory's FY2015 revenue, and the combined share of the 10 (ties broken by item id).
assemble: WITH t AS (SELECT sales_territory, revenue AS territory_revenue FROM territories WHERE lines > 0 ORDER BY revenue DESC, sales_territory LIMIT 1), ranked AS (SELECT i.wwi_stock_item_id, i.stock_item, i.revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.revenue DESC, i.wwi_stock_item_id) AS rank_no FROM items i JOIN t USING (sales_territory) WHERE i.lines > 0), top10 AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rank_no <= 10) SELECT t.sales_territory, x.rank_no, x.wwi_stock_item_id, x.stock_item, x.revenue, x.revenue / t.territory_revenue AS share_of_territory, (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM top10) / t.territory_revenue AS top10_combined_share FROM top10 x CROSS JOIN t ORDER BY x.rank_no
